adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync branch returns the raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object. Multiple callers shown in the diff expect non-`fetch` response shapes: e.g. Google Calendar does `const token = res?.data;` after calling `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`, but a `fetch` Response has no `.data` property, so `token` becomes `undefined` in sync mode and subsequent `token.access_token` access will break. Hubspot assigns the return value to `HubspotToken` (`const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`), but in sync mode it would be a `Response`, not a `HubspotToken`, causing wrong-shaped token usage. The diff contains no adaptation/parsing in `refreshOAuthTokens` to normalize the return type for callers.
